SUBJECTHEAD.description: Subject header prefix to prepend to subject lines (must include trailing space if desired); empty string disables subject rewriting

CLAMSCAN.description: Full path to clamscan or clamdscan binary

CLAMSCANOPT.description: Command-line options passed to the clamscanner binary

ADDSCANNERFLAG.description: Whether to add scanner name/version to the X-Virus-Scanned header

SIGVERSFLAG.description: Whether to add virus signature version to the X-Virus-Signature header (default: off for ClamAV ≥ 0.80)
